name: Asymmetric Lobe Approximation
definition: An approximation technique that replaces full 4D spherical lobes with asymmetric 1D functions to reduce computational cost, focusing on multiple scattering.
summary: Asymmetric Lobe Approximation accelerates multiple scattering in participating media by replacing full 4D phase functions with asymmetric 1D functions, differing from sibling methods by simplifying angular representation rather than spatial spread.
